project.title: analythis
project.tagline: A framework-agnostic repository analysis tool that produces machine-readable blueprints and human-facing reports.

summary.short: analythis analyzes local folders or Git repositories to infer structure, architecture, modules, entities, APIs, risks, and reusable parts, then exports machine-readable blueprints and Markdown reports.
summary.long: Version 1.0 intentionally uses heuristic analysis for fast structured context. It generates inventory, blueprint, prompt-pack, Markdown, and YAML outputs, supports web/backend/mobile/library/monorepo profiles, and is designed to feed coding agents, refactor planning, regeneration, core extraction, and onboarding workflows.

highlights: Local folder and Git URL analysis
Prompt packs for refactoring, regeneration, extraction, and onboarding
